description: This file contains pytest-based asynchronous test cases for the DynamoAIGuardrails class, which tests its behavior in blocking or allowing content based on API responses from DynamoAI Guardrails. It mocks external API interactions and verifies that the guardrail responds correctly to different 'finalAction' scenarios.

classes.name: DynamoAIGuardrails
classes.description: A class responsible for integrating DynamoAI guardrails, including API call handling and decision logic based on responses.

methods.name: test_dynamoai_blocks_content_with_block_action()
methods.description: Test that the guardrail blocks content when the API response indicates 'BLOCK' via finalAction.

methods.name: test_dynamoai_allows_content_with_none_action()
methods.description: Test that the guardrail allows content when the API response indicates 'NONE' via finalAction.
